title: SSAG Photo-to-Dance Motion Transfer
definition_of_done: A real private CUDA job accepts consented character photo plus licensed motion reference and produces an identity-reviewed downloadable MP4 with successful deletion and logged evidence.

owner_frontend.note: Published UI is not proof of motion generation

gpu_api.note: Executable code and CI tests do not mean deployed GPU service

blocker: No owner-controlled NVIDIA CUDA GPU host with Motion Mirror and model weights is connected. Avoid paid signups without owner consent.
next_action: Provide or obtain a permitted GPU compute environment meeting Motion Mirror's documented requirements; configure secure API and run consented photo-plus-reference video generation, then verify and record real MP4 output.
note: Never mark READY based on a live page, a passed CPU API test, mock video, or an upstream GitHub README alone.
